# Accessories

Necklaces, belts, bracelets and rings (kinds 54–57), wearable by every class.

Tier (T1–T3) is a property of each copy, not of the item row: the client multiplies the first three stat slots by *tier × 15 + reinforce level* (see any item page). Rows are grouped by grade instead.

105 items. Back to [[wiki/items/index\|Items]]; other categories: [[wiki/items/weapons-saint\|Saint weapons]] · [[wiki/items/weapons-punisher\|Punisher weapons]] · [[wiki/items/weapons-guardian\|Guardian weapons]] · [[wiki/items/armor-helmet\|Helmets]] · [[wiki/items/armor-body\|Body armour]] · [[wiki/items/armor-gloves\|Gloves]] · [[wiki/items/armor-shoes\|Shoes]] · [[wiki/items/runes\|Runes and gem stones]] · [[wiki/items/costume-items\|Costume items]] · [[wiki/items/hero-items\|Innocence (hero) items]] · [[wiki/items/consumables\|Consumables]] · [[wiki/items/materials\|Materials]] · [[wiki/items/quest-items\|Quest items]] · [[wiki/items/boxes-and-packages\|Boxes and packages]] · [[wiki/items/other-items\|Other items]].
